description: Buy a Base token that is not in initiate_crypto_trade's catalogue, by contract address, spending the user's own USD, EUR, CHF or MXN balance. Use initiate_crypto_trade for catalogue assets (cbBTC, WETH, …). The token must be tradeable on Base via LiFi. Creates a request the user reviews at the live price, approves and signs in the Moneda mobile app. After calling, poll get_payment_status.

amount.description: How much to spend, in stableCurrency (e.g. '25')

stableCurrency.description: The user's balance the buy is paid from

name: initiate_token_buy
